name: robots/klintan__ros2_usb_camera
title: ROS 2 USB camera images and calibration
intro: ROS 2 USB camera images and calibration, adapted from klintan/ros2_usb_camera. It reads `frame_id`, `read_camera_calibration` and `read_camera_info`; runs `capture`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
